FMUZZLE89 v6 validation report
===============================

Geometry defaults verified
--------------------------
- Cylinder length: 2.0 cm
- Cone length: 18.0 cm
- Combined axial length: 20.0 cm
- Cylinder diameter: 2.5 cm
- Cone base diameter: 2.5 cm
- Shared fixed-point radius: 1.25 cm
- Primary and repeated fin banks remain anchored at z=0 on the cylinder base ring.
- Square sheets remain disabled.

Strict C89 build
----------------
Command:
  gcc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 \
      fmuzzle89.c demo_render.c -o demo_render

Result:
  PASS

Automated geometry tests
------------------------
Command:
  gcc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 \
      fmuzzle89.c test_fmuzzle89.c -o test_fmuzzle89
  ./test_fmuzzle89

Result:
  FMUZZLE89 v6: all fixed-point geometry tests passed.

32-bit library object check
---------------------------
Command:
  gcc -m32 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 \
      -c fmuzzle89.c -o fmuzzle89_32.o

Result:
  PASS: ELF 32-bit Intel i386 relocatable object.

The container does not provide the 32-bit libc development headers required to
link the stdio-based demo and test executables under -m32. The library source
itself was compiled successfully as a 32-bit object. The included MinGW32 batch
file builds the demo and tests using the user's 32-bit MSYS2/MinGW environment.

Storage and arithmetic scan
---------------------------
The .c and .h sources contain no token references to:
  malloc, realloc, free, float, double

The implementation uses Q10 fixed point and bounded arrays only.

Preview provenance
------------------
The executable generated 48 animation frames and two deterministic side-profile
frames as binary PPM images. The included PNG/GIF previews were converted and
assembled directly from those C-rendered PPM frames; their muzzle geometry was
not generated or redrawn by an image model.

Additional v8 preview check passed: front and animated renders show the open-root triangle outline and cylinder-base anchoring.

Additional v9 geometry check passed: 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 deterministic generation validated with cone-base anchors at z = 2 cm and 1.25 cm tertiary repeats.
